item_name: Rothco Vintage Air Corps Fatigue Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Vintage Air Corps Fatigue Cap combines classic style with modern durability. Made from a lightweight and durable cotton blend, this cap features washed twill fabric and distressed details that give it an authentic vintage look and feel. The iconic Air Corps Star emblem is prominently displayed on the front center, making it a standout accessory for history enthusiasts and those who love timeless designs. With multiple sizes available, this cap offers a comfortable, tailored fit for all-day wear.
